name: AST SpaceMobile, Inc.
summary: AST SpaceMobile, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs and develops the constellation of BlueBird satellites in the United States. The company provides a cellular broadband network in space to be accessible directly by smartphones for commercial use and other applications, as well as for government use. Its SpaceMobile service provides cellular broadband services to end-users who are out of terrestrial cellular coverage. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Midland, Texas.
leadership_credibility: Proven telecom entrepreneur who previously built and sold EMC for $550M. Directing execution of first space-based direct-to-cell cellular broadband constellation.
insider_alignment: 🟢 ACTIVE C-SUITE BUYING: Cisneros Adriana ($499.8k) ($621.8k total management accumulation). Insiders hold ~8.01% equity.
moat_type: Proprietary Phased-Array Satellite Architecture, 3,400+ Patents/Applications, Strategic Telco Partnerships (AT&T, Verizon, Vodafone)
moat_durability: High barrier to entry due to satellite spectrum priority, custom ASIC chipsets, and long-term carrier revenue share agreements.
moat_intangibles: 3,400+ satellite patents, FCC & ITU spectrum priority rights, and custom low-power beamforming ASIC silicon.
moat_network_effects: Carrier revenue-share moat: partnered with tier-1 operators (AT&T, Verizon, Vodafone, Rakuten) representing over 2.8B global subscribers.
moat_pricing_power: Scale & Volume Cost Advantage: Operating margins supported by high-volume throughput and lean unit cost structure (38.9% gross margin).
tam_description: Direct-to-device connectivity for 5+ billion global mobile subscribers and billions of unconnected cellular users (> $1.1 Trillion TAM potential).
tam_sanity_check: Pioneering Phase: Zero commercial revenue baselined against a massive $1.1T mobile telecom addressable pool; binary commercialization upside.
tam_optionality: Government and military defense communications (FirstNet / DoD), maritime broadband, and global emergency response roaming.

operations.summary: AST SpaceMobile, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs and develops the constellation of BlueBird satellites in the United States. operations.revenue_model: Wholesale 50/50 revenue-share model with terrestrial mobile network operators (MNOs) where end consumers subscribe to satellite add-on packages directly from their existing mobile carrier.
operations.geographic_footprint: Global orbital footprint targeting United States, Europe, Latin America, Africa, and Asia-Pacific mobile users.

Capital burn requiring equity dilution or debt
